title: Two Ways Lab
tagline: Same problem. Two methods. Let's test.
about:
Everyday problems. Two ways to solve them. Which one actually works better?

At Two Ways Lab, we put simple methods head-to-head — packing, sorting, cleaning, queues, travel, and the little decisions we make every day.

Same starting conditions. Clear rules. Visual results.

Sometimes there's a winner. Sometimes the answer depends on the situation.

Pick your side, watch the experiment, and see what happens.

Short experiments and deeper breakdowns, built from original simulations.
name: Two Ways Lab
